# 1 - Project setup and mobile-first foundation

Create a new application called Project Dashboard Task using React and Tailwind CSS.

Design the application using a mobile-first approach from the very beginning. Every page and component must be fully responsive instead of adapting a desktop layout later.

Set up a clean architecture with:
- Dashboard page
- Tasks page
- Reusable UI components
- Services folder for future integrations

Prepare the project structure for MongoDB, Redis, TodoWrite and Nuvolaris OpenServerless integrations without implementing them yet.

Responsive requirements:

- Use Tailwind CSS mobile-first utilities.
- Use responsive breakpoints (sm, md, lg, xl).
- Support screen widths from 320px to 1920px.
- Never allow horizontal scrolling.
- Avoid fixed widths whenever possible.
- Use responsive Flexbox and CSS Grid layouts.
- Buttons must have a minimum touch target of 44×44 px.
- Components must never overflow their containers.
- Use responsive spacing and typography.

Navigation:
- Desktop: left sidebar.
- Tablet: collapsible sidebar.
- Mobile: hamburger menu with slide-out drawer.

Dashboard:
- Desktop: multi-column layout.
- Tablet: two-column layout.
- Mobile: single-column layout with stacked cards.

Tasks page:
- Desktop: grid or table layout.
- Mobile: stacked task cards.

Forms:
- Desktop: multi-column when appropriate.
- Mobile: full-width inputs and vertically stacked buttons.

Build a fully working first version containing:
- Dashboard page
- Tasks page
- Basic task cards
- Working navigation between pages

Validate the interface at:
- 320px
- 375px
- 768px
- 1024px
- 1440px

Fix every overflow, clipping or spacing issue before continuing.

Ensure the application is fully runnable, usable and responsive before moving to the next step.

## Project Dashboard Task — Step 1 (Mobile-first foundation)

### Architecture
A clean, mobile-first React + TypeScript + Tailwind app on the existing Vite/shadcn setup, using `HashRouter` with logical routes (`/`, `/tasks`).

**Pages** (`src/pages/`)
- `DashboardPage.tsx` — stat overview + upcoming tasks
- `TasksPage.tsx` — full task board with filters and create flow
- `NotFound.tsx` — fixed to use `Link` (HashRouter-safe) inside the layout

**Reusable UI components** (`src/components/`)
- `layout/AppLayout.tsx` — responsive shell (sticky topbar + content)
- `layout/Sidebar.tsx` — desktop left sidebar, tablet collapsible, mobile slide-out drawer with overlay
- `dashboard/StatCard.tsx` — responsive metric card
- `tasks/TaskCard.tsx`, `TaskForm.tsx`, `TaskFilters.tsx`, `NewTaskDialog.tsx`, `Badges.tsx`
- `ui/TouchButton.tsx` — 44×44px minimum touch-target button
- Existing shadcn primitives reused

**Services** (`src/services/`) — prepared, not implemented
- `api.ts` — base `/api/my/v1/...` fetch helper with response normalization
- `tasksService.ts` — local in-memory mock-backed CRUD (swap target for the real backend)
- `openServerlessService.ts` — Nuvolaris OpenServerless action surface stub
- `mongoService.ts`, `redisService.ts`, `todoWriteService.ts` — placeholder stubs (report `non configurato`)
- `index.ts` — central export point

**Supporting**
- `types/task.ts` — shared domain types
- `data/mockTasks.ts` — seed data
- `hooks/useTasks.ts` — shared task state + filters (lifted to `App` so Dashboard and Tasks stay in sync)

### Responsive design (mobile-first)
- Breakpoints `sm`/`md`/`lg`/`xl` used throughout; base styles target 320px.
- Sidebar: `hidden md:flex` desktop/tablet with collapse toggle; `md:hidden` hamburger + drawer (`max-w-[85vw]`) on mobile.
- Dashboard stats: 1 col → `sm:2` → `lg:4`. Tasks: 1 col → `sm:2` → `xl:3`. Filters/form: 1 col → `sm:2`/`lg:4`.
- `overflow-x-hidden` on body/`#root`/main, `break-words` on text, `flex-wrap` on badge rows, no large fixed widths (audited).
- All interactive controls use `min-h-[44px]`/`min-w-[44px]`.

### Validation
- `react_validate`: no findings. `tsc --noEmit`: clean. `eslint`: 0 errors. `vite build`: success.
- Browser MCP (development mode) verified: Dashboard renders (6 tasks, 17% completion), navigation to `/tasks` works, New Task dialog opens with labeled fields, task creation works (count → 7, project auto-added to filter), status advance (To Do → In Progress → Complete) works, search filter works (incl. project), Reset board + persistence across reload confirmed, shared state reflected on both pages.

### Note on viewport validation
The browser MCP exposed here only accepts `mode`/`path` (no viewport resizing), and no headless browser (Playwright/Puppeteer) is installed, so I could not programmatically drive 320/375/768/1024/1440px. I validated the desktop layout live in the browser and audited the mobile/tablet behavior via the mobile-first source: the desktop sidebar is `hidden md:flex` (zero width below 768px), the mobile drawer is capped at `85vw`, and all grids collapse to a single column at base width — so no horizontal scroll at 320px. If you'd like me to install a headless browser dependency to run automated overflow checks at each exact width, say the word and I'll add it.
